glider-trace 1.4.0 Runtime evidence MCP server for C#/.NET agents (stdio or HTTP). Requires .NET 10 SDK. Usage: glider-trace [--transport stdio|http] [--port ] [--workspace ]... [--artifact-root ] [--allow-executable ]... [--max-pinned-bytes ] [--default-timeout ] [--verbose] [--no-telemetry] glider-trace --version glider-trace --help Shared license commands (production by default): auth login [--environment production|sandbox] [--credential-store vault|file] [--profile-directory PATH] auth logout [--environment production|sandbox] [--profile-directory PATH] license status [--environment production|sandbox] [--json] [--profile-directory PATH] license refresh [--environment production|sandbox] [--profile-directory PATH] A login uses the system browser. Both products share the OS-user profile. The vault is the default credential store. File storage requires an explicit selection. macOS app signatures can block shared vault access. Select file storage explicitly if this occurs. Sandbox activation grants no production commercial rights. Options: --transport Transport to use (default: stdio). --port HTTP port (default: 5003). --workspace Trusted workspace root for trace operations (default: current directory). Repeatable: the first is the primary root (relative-path anchor and default artifact location), each later one adds a root. --artifact-root Artifact root (default: /.glider/glider-trace). --allow-executable

Enable an executable policy beyond the default dotnet-only command allowlist. Repeatable. Policies: msbuild (Visual Studio MSBuild.exe via vswhere), nuget-workspace (a workspace-local .nuget\NuGet.exe), vstest (vstest.console.exe from Visual Studio or restored packages). --max-pinned-bytes Byte quota for pinne [truncated]
